# FDGA020

> DO indent `case` blocks even if not using braces.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.3 Indent Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_indent_switch_labels = true
csharp_indent_case_contents = true
```

## From the book

```csharp
switch (someExpression)
{
    case 0:
        DoSomething();
        break;
    ...
}
```
